name: shophop
description: Several Shopify stores at once from Claude: read-only by default, audit log, B2B company copy with production approvals.
long_description: shophop lets Claude work with several Shopify stores at the same time. Every tool names its store, so there is no shared active shop. Sign-in uses the Shopify CLI with your staff account, so no custom app is needed. Stores are read-only until you allow edits in the Shop Manager; deletes need separate access, copies into production need your approval, and every change is logged. Requires the Shopify CLI 4.9 or later on this computer.

tools.name: list_shops
tools.description: List stores, what Claude may do on each, and the Shopify CLI version

tools.name: open_shop_manager
tools.description: Open the Shop Manager to add stores, sign in, set access and approve production copies

tools.name: shop_query
tools.description: Read-only Admin GraphQL query on one store

tools.name: shop_schema
tools.description: Look up a store's Admin API schema

tools.name: shop_mutation
tools.description: Run a mutation on one store, if the store allows it

tools.name: shop_bulk_export
tools.description: Start a bulk export to a local file

tools.name: shop_bulk_status
tools.description: Check and download a bulk export

tools.name: shop_copy_companies
tools.description: Copy B2B companies between stores: dry run, approval, apply

prompts.name: shops
prompts.text: Open the shophop Shop Manager (open_shop_manager) and wait. When I say I'm done, call list_shops and summarize the stores.

data_dir.title: Export folder (optional)
data_dir.description: Folder where bulk exports, copy plans and ID maps are saved, e.g. /Users/you/shophop-data. Leave empty to use ~/shophop-data.

shopify_cli.title: Shopify CLI path (optional)
shopify_cli.description: Leave empty: shophop finds the `shopify` command by itself. Only if it says it cannot, run `which shopify` in Terminal and paste the path here.

api_version.title: Admin API version (optional)
api_version.description: Pin a version like 2026-10 to save about half a second per call. Leave empty for the latest stable.
